barWidget.description: System-update indicator in the dizziee model: the Hexciri and Arch updates are one combined section whose update runs `hexciri update`, never a bare pacman -Syu. Per-source rows (AUR, Flatpak, Plugins & Themes, mise) with pending packages and their own safe updater. Nerd Font package icon when clean, package-variant icon plus count when updates are waiting. Left click opens the update list, right click opens settings, middle click refreshes.
